extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML tables, figure captions, PDF text, and supplementary text; claims are bounded to the assays actually present.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RNase3, RNase6, RN6(1-45), and RNase6 mutants show LPS binding/displacement activity in primary tables; reduced binding for W1A/I13A is treated as direct in vitro mechanism evidence for LPS interaction, not as in vivo causality.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Assay is in vitro LPS binding/displacement; no animal infection outcome is inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RNase3, RNase6, and RN6(1-45) disrupt DOPC/DOPG model liposomes and depolarize bacterial cells in source tables.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model membrane and depolarization assays support membrane interaction/permeation; they do not identify a single molecular receptor.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RNase6 and RN6(1-45) show bacterial agglutination activity against E. coli; Trp1 and Ile13 mutant comparisons support these residues as determinants of the agglutination/LPS-binding phenotype.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Residue determinant claim is bounded to the tested mutants and in vitro bacterial agglutination/activity assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Live/Dead kinetics and microscopy support rapid bactericidal phenotype and bacterial envelope damage for the tested proteins/peptide.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotype and morphology evidence supports envelope damage/permeation but is not normalized into exact figure-derived numeric values beyond the table data.
